about.heroTitle: Giving every place in Guinea an address
about.heroText: Adresse GN assigns every building, shop or plot a unique number materialised by a physical beacon. That number is enough to find the exact location and go there.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.text: Every position is recorded on site by a certified agent, then reviewed before publication.

privacy.title: Privacy first
privacy.text: A residential address stays private by default: only the people you give the number to can see it.

utility.title: Immediate usefulness
utility.text: No theory: a number, a map, a route that opens in your navigation app.

local.title: Local roots
local.text: The network of installer agents is recruited and trained in the neighbourhoods it covers.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: In Guinea, explaining where you live often takes several minutes, a phone call and a few approximate landmarks. That friction costs families time, couriers lost trips and shops revenue. Our mission is to replace that explanation with a number you can write, dictate or send in one second.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: We are building a national addressing layer open to public services and private companies alike: emergency response, logistics, e-commerce, transport, water and electricity distribution. Every address verified today makes those services faster tomorrow.

why.quote: “An address is not an administrative detail. It is what makes it possible to be delivered to, rescued, visited — and therefore to exist in the economy.”

team.title: The team
team.text: Adresse GN brings together operations, field and technology profiles. Individual introductions will be published here.
